comparison.objective: Hold a stencil flat and dab once through each of three holes; candidate finishes four threaded inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual surface stabilization and repeated normal dauber contact versus coaxial mandrel stabilization, impulsive hammer striking, off-axis load control, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Stencil held flat and each hole dabbed once before lifting the tool versus four contact-loaded fractures, four recovered free tangs, no damage, and stable release. Paint/contact thresholds are unspecified.
comparison.reason: The shared hold-and-strike pattern is superficial: gentle marking through apertures does not test fracture, retained-component protection, or debris containment.
